categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Canmax New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: new energy lithium battery materials, anti-static and ultra-clean technology products, and medical devices. The lithium battery materials segment focuses on battery-grade lithium hydroxide and lithium carbonate used in cathode materials for lithium-ion batteries. The anti-static and ultra-clean technology products serve high-precision industries such as electronics manufacturing and biomedicine. The medical devices segment includes high-pressure syringes, safety syringes, and related medical consumables.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced production technologies including lithium hydroxide carbonation processes for lithium carbonate production, nanocoating and single-crystal technologies for high-nickel cathode materials, and innovative plasma and electrostatic control technologies for anti-static products. It integrates ERP, MES, and other intelligent manufacturing systems to enhance production efficiency and quality. The company also invests in R&D for next-generation battery technologies such as solid-state batteries and flow batteries, collaborating with top academic institutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading electric vehicle manufacturers, lithium-ion battery producers, and cathode material manufacturers in the new energy sector. The anti-static products primarily serve semiconductor, new display, storage, and biomedical industries. Medical device customers are mainly hospitals, clinics, and health departments. The company has established long-term partnerships with major domestic and international clients, including several top-tier automotive and battery companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Sichuan, Jiangxi, and Jiangsu provinces. It has a global supply chain and resource layout covering Africa, South America, Oceania, and Asia through subsidiaries and equity investments. Overseas sales account for approximately 18% of revenue, with active engagement in international markets including Europe, North America, Africa, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou Canmax operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the lithium-ion battery supply chain. It produces key lithium salt raw materials (lithium hydroxide and lithium carbonate) essential for cathode material manufacturing and is expanding into cathode material production and solid-state battery technologies. The company also provides anti-static and ultra-clean solutions critical for downstream high-tech manufacturing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-nickel and lithium-rich cathode materials, solid-state battery electrolytes, and advanced anti-static technologies. It emphasizes R&D collaboration with universities and research institutes to develop next-generation battery materials and medical devices. Strategic goals include expanding upstream lithium resource control, enhancing intelligent manufacturing, and advancing green and sustainable production practices.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of lithium battery materials, anti-static and ultra-clean products, and medical devices. The company operates a self-production and self-sales model, with sales to industrial clients and OEMs. It also engages in contract manufacturing and provides integrated solutions, with revenue recognized upon transfer of control to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic producer of lithium battery raw materials and anti-static technology products, competing with major Chinese and international lithium material suppliers. It holds a strong market position through technological innovation, quality, and integrated supply capabilities. Its medical device segment competes in a niche market with a focus on high-pressure and safety syringes, maintaining competitive advantages through innovation and certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately 6.6 billion RMB, a 36.87% decrease from 2023, mainly due to lower lithium material prices and sales volume. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about 848 million RMB, down 48.91% year-over-year. The company has a total asset base of around 17.5 billion RMB and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion. Despite recent revenue declines, it maintains a solid financial foundation and growth potential driven by the expanding new energy market.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suzhou Canmax emphasizes high product purity, advanced manufacturing processes, and stringent quality control to ensure superior lithium salt products with low impurity levels, enhancing battery safety and performance. Its integrated anti-static and ultra-clean solutions provide tailored, high-performance contamination control for precision industries. The company’s commitment to innovation, sustainability, and customer-centric solutions differentiates it in the competitive new energy and medical device markets.
